newsitem.title: USA: Shoney's founder says may sue company.
newsitem.headline: Shoney's founder says may sue company.

text.p: The founder and former chief executive of Shoney's Inc said Wednesday he is considering suing the company for $106 million for alleged breach of contract.
Ray Danner, in a statement, alleged that the company failed to purchase his Shoney's stock at the $22.875 per share price agreed on in 1993.
"This price was offered by the company for purchase of my more than 4.6 million shares, then valued at over $106 million," Danner said.
He said he is the company's largest single shareholder.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
Danner said he was reviewing other options, including suing Shoney's for allegedly withholding records.
